transcript:
Interviewer: Walk me through how vector indexing works in your RAG platform.
Candidate: Sure. We basically store the documents in the vector database and search them by keywords. I think the index just keeps the text so the search is faster.
Interviewer: How did you choose between HNSW and IVF for the index?
Candidate: I'm not sure, that was set up before I joined the project. We used the default settings.
Interviewer: You led the search service migration to Kubernetes. What was your role?
Candidate: Honestly my lead handled the backend and the cluster work. I mostly wrote the documentation and the runbooks for the migration.
Interviewer: Tell me about a disagreement with a teammate.
Candidate: I always listen first, then we agree on a plan. I've mentored three juniors and everyone enjoyed it, it was a great experience.
